'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Vikram Bali DS Court Of The Vile Gangster''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Vikram Bali]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet deck name '''Scrub'''; margin DVD ROTS.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / Yes, I Think They're Still Getting Louder]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
